upgradeFaqTrialA: Yes. Pro starts with a {{trialDays}}-day free trial, and there's a {{moneyBackDays}}-day money-back guarantee after your first charge.
upgradeFaqCancelA: Anytime. You keep Pro until the end of the billing period, then drop back to the (still generous) free plan.
upgradeFaqCompareQ: What do I keep on the free plan?
upgradeFaqCompareA: Everything you use to research and track stocks: stock pages, charts, the screener, holdings, alerts and the beginner Academy, with no monthly report caps. Pro adds the AI analyst on top.
upgradeFaqLimitsQ: What counts against the AI limits?
upgradeFaqLimitsA: Only the AI features (chat, Deep Dive, Portfolio Builder, Portfolio Checkup). Everything else, charts, screener, alerts, holdings, Academy, is unlimited on free.
upgradeHeroDescription: Free keeps the whole app. Pro adds an analyst that briefs you every morning, explains every big move and answers anything you ask.

upgradeFaqCardA: Yes. Checkout asks for a card so Pro can continue after the trial, but nothing is charged for {{trialDays}} days, and we email you 3 days before it ends. Cancel before then and you pay nothing. The free plan never needs a card.
